title: Check OptiSweep System State and Sort GUID in SSMS
summary: Use the WCS / Helix DB (SSMS) to perform a read-only check of the Helix2x_1Prod_Robotics dbo.SystemDatabaseModel record. Verify the current system lifecycle Status, SortGuid, EntityInserted, and EntityLastUpdate values.
when_to_use: Use the WCS / Helix DB (SSMS) when troubleshooting or validating the current OptiSweep system lifecycle state and associated sort identifier. This diagnostic verifies the live SystemDatabaseModel record without changing system state.
not_for: Do not use this read-only diagnostic to start up, shut down, close out, purge, reset metrics, or update zone configuration.
Do not use it as a physical AGV recovery or safety-stop procedure.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support performs the read-only inspection in the WCS / Helix DB (SSMS).
L3_support may review the returned record or assist when the database record cannot be opened or contains missing or unrecognized state values.
safety_notes: This procedure is read-only and does not include lifecycle commands or recovery actions.
Do not modify the database record while performing this diagnostic.

access_required: L2/L3 access to the WCS / Helix DB (SSMS)
system_preconditions: The Helix2x_1Prod_Robotics database is available in SSMS.
The dbo.SystemDatabaseModel table/model can be opened or queried read-only.
external_references: SystemDatabaseModel lifecycle status values supplied in the source evidence
